data.one_liner: Adds support for Markdown description/definition lists to the markdown package
data.what_it_does: Provides a Syntax class that can be added to markdown's block syntaxes to parse description lists. It renders them as HTML definition lists.
use_when: You need to parse or render Markdown that contains definition lists
You are already using the markdown package and want minimal extra code
avoid_when: You are not using markdown or need a full Markdown parser replacement
You need advanced Markdown extensions beyond description lists
strengths: Simple API, no build_runner or codegen
Supports custom term limits and indentation rules
weaknesses: Only supports description lists, no other extensions
No UI widgets, only parsing logic
data.setup_notes: Add markdown and markdown_description_list to pubspec, import the library, and include DescriptionListSyntax in Document or markdownToHtml
